title: POLICE RAID AT MIDNIGHT! 👮‍♂️
topic: The fallout of the stolen scholarship money and a massive betrayal.
bg_hints: city sirens and flashing blue lights
working quickly in a messy room

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: MOM, GET DOWN! [beat] THE COPS ARE LITERALLY TEARING THE FRONT DOOR OFF ITS HINGES RIGHT NOW!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Shut your mouth, Riku! [beat] I told you to hide that briefcase in the attic before the principal's tracker went live!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: You said that money was an inheritance from Grandpa, [beat] but those sirens aren't for a simple tax audit, Mom!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Step away from the desk, Lubna! [beat] You didn't think a humble school principal would notice two million dollars missing?

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Huda, you've got it all wrong! [beat] I was just holding that cash to keep it safe from Jamal’s gambling debts!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: Don't you dare bring my name into your filthy web of lies, [beat] you backstabbing, thieving excuse for a sister!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait... [beat] why is the principal wearing a wire, and why is Uncle Jamal holding a master key to our house?

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Because your mother isn't the only one who wanted a piece of the pie, [beat] but she's the only one going to jail.

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: Lubna, tell me this isn't true! [beat] Tell me our entire life hasn't been funded by stolen grants and student lunch money!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: You enjoyed the luxury cars and the vacations just fine, Rafiq, [beat] so don't act like a pathetic saint now!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: Hand over the digital key to the offshore account, Lubna, [beat] or I’ll make sure the police find the bag under Nix’s bed.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: There is nothing under my bed! [beat] You guys are framing me just to keep the rest of the loot for yourselves!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Search the kid's room immediately! [beat] If we find that hard drive, the principal’s files will be closed for good!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nix thought his mom was the villain, [beat] but he just realized he’s the one being set up as the fall guy.
